title: zerna richardsonii

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing swelling and pain in the body. The bioactive constituents of Zerna richardsonii include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of health benefits.
